title: SetErrorType::Display allocates via serde_json::to_value on every format
description: backend.rs:154-163: Display impl serializes self via serde_json::to_value(...).ok().and_then(|v| v.as_str().map(|s| s.to_owned())), then unwraps with a Debug fallback. This allocates a String from a JSON Value on every display call. It also silently falls back to Debug format if serde fails. A simple match arm on each variant (like thiserror does) is zero-allocation and cannot silently degrade. Fix: use a match expression returning &'static str, as is idiomatic for Display on simple string-valued enums.
